What is this violation? show
Failure to register as a landlord. T.C.A. § 66-28-101 requires each landlord of one or more dwelling units within Davidson County to pay a $10 registration fee and furnish (A) the landlord (or agent) name, address and phone; and (B) the street address and unit number of each dwelling unit the landlord owns, leases, or subleases. Fee due with Metro property taxes. Landlord Registration, 800 Second Avenue South, 3rd Floor, Nashville, TN 37210 · www.nashville.gov/codes · 615-862-6590.
